# 5th Script: Summary Table

## Purpose

This document builds the project's **"beautiful tidy table"**
(assignment step 2: *"Visualize a subset of the data in a beautiful tidy
table"*) for our question:

> **How do the occurrence (distribution) and abundance of invasive and
> native algae compare across OPIHI intertidal surveys, 2004–2026,
> accounting for sampling effort?**

It reads only the cleaned, de-identified outputs in `Data/Processed/`
(the `_completed` versions, which add the team's post-cleaning
corrections listed in `opihi_change_log.csv`) and the team's algae
origin lookup in `Data/Algae/`. It does not touch the raw data. The
table is saved to `Outputs/` as a PNG (for slides and the README) and as
HTML, along with a CSV of every algal taxon.

## Design choices

| Choice | Why | Assignment link |
|------------------------|------------------------|------------------------|
| **Metric = % of quadrats where a taxon was recorded**, with the number of quadrats and sites shown in each column header | Detection frequency divides by effort (quadrats sampled), so sites and years sampled more heavily don't look "richer" just because of effort | Question C: *"detection-frequency summary, accounting for sampling effort"* |
| **Distribution = number of sites and islands** where each taxon was recorded | Answers *where*, alongside *when* (the period columns) | Question C: *"where and when was it recorded?"* |
| **Abundance = mean % cover where present** (points hit ÷ 25) | Separates how common a taxon is from how much space it takes up once it is there | Our question compares abundance as well as distribution |
| **Three sampling periods** (2004–2008, 2016–2020, 2024–2026) | OPIHI data fall in these three blocks; there are no surveys 2009–2015 or 2021–2023 at quadrat level | Shows change over time without implying a continuous trend |
| **Origin status from the team's `algae_origin_review.csv` / `algae_origin_lookup.csv`** | One shared classification for the table and both figures; anything a teammate fills into `your_status` overrides the default | Documented decisions; consistency across the report |
| **Only species-level IDs are classed native or invasive**; genus-only records, uncertain-origin species and functional groups are summarised separately | Genera such as *Hypnea* and *Gracilaria* contain both native and invasive species, so genus-level records can't honestly be assigned | Taxonomic care; *"don't draw broad conclusions"* |
| **Quadrat-level records only** (classroom group totals and cyanobacteria excluded, stated in the table note) | Group totals cannot give per-quadrat detection; cyanobacteria are not algae | Explained exclusions |
| **8 most widespread native taxa shown; all taxa written to CSV** | Keeps the table readable while losing nothing | Tidy subset of the data |
| **No teacher IDs or names; no statistics** | Table uses only site, island, year and taxon; the summary is exploratory | Data stewardship; *"statistics are not expected"* |

## First Steps

```{r setup-summary-table}
# reuse the folders set up in the 1st script
PROC_DIR <- CLEAN_DIR
OUT_DIR  <- OUTPUT_DIR
```

## Data

The `_completed` files are the cleaned outputs plus the corrections in
`opihi_change_log.csv`. Of those, only one reaches this table: Sandy
Beach West was merged into Sandy Beach, so site counts fall by one where
both were sampled. The other corrections concern the 2023 classroom
survey (excluded here as a group total) or non-algae taxa.

```{r read-data}
# "_completed" = cleaned outputs + team corrections (see opihi_change_log.csv).
# Set VERSION <- "" to rebuild the table from the original pipeline outputs.
VERSION <- "_completed"
read_proc <- \(name) read_csv(file.path(PROC_DIR, paste0(name, VERSION, ".csv")), show_col_types = FALSE)

master  <- read_proc("opihi_master")
samples <- read_proc("opihi_samples")
surveys <- read_proc("opihi_surveys")

knitr::kable(read_csv(file.path(PROC_DIR, "opihi_change_log.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE),
             caption = "Team corrections applied in the completed files (opihi_change_log.csv).")

# Team origin classification. The lookup holds every alga, including functional
# groups; the review file holds team corrections in `your_status` (blank = keep).
origin <- read_csv(file.path(ALGAE_DIR, "algae_origin_lookup.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(taxon_clean, origin_status)
review_path <- file.path(ALGAE_DIR, "algae_origin_review.csv")
if (file.exists(review_path)) {
  review <- read_csv(review_path, show_col_types = FALSE, col_types = cols(.default = "c")) |>
    filter(!is.na(your_status), str_trim(your_status) != "") |>
    select(taxon_clean, your_status)
  origin <- origin |>
    left_join(review, by = "taxon_clean") |>
    mutate(origin_status = coalesce(str_trim(your_status), origin_status)) |>
    select(-your_status)
}

STATUS_LEVELS <- c("Non-native (invasive)", "Native (likely)", "Unresolved (check)",
                   "Unresolved (genus-level)", "Not assignable (functional group)")
bad_status <- setdiff(unique(origin$origin_status), STATUS_LEVELS)
if (length(bad_status) > 0) {
  stop("Unknown origin_status value(s) in the lookup/review: ", paste(bad_status, collapse = "; "),
       "\nAllowed: ", paste(STATUS_LEVELS, collapse = "; "))
}
```

### Sampling effort

Effort is every quadrat in `opihi_samples_completed.csv`, **including
quadrats where no alga was recorded**. The master lists only detections,
so it cannot supply the denominator.

```{r effort}
period_of <- function(year) {
  factor(case_when(year <= 2008 ~ "p1", year <= 2020 ~ "p2", TRUE ~ "p3"),
         levels = c("p1", "p2", "p3"))
}
PERIOD_LABELS <- c(p1 = "2004–2008", p2 = "2016–2020", p3 = "2024–2026")

effort <- samples |>
  filter(sample_type == "quadrat") |>
  select(sample_id, survey_id) |>
  left_join(select(surveys, survey_id, year, site_name, island), by = "survey_id") |>
  mutate(period = period_of(year))

period_info <- effort |>
  group_by(period) |>
  summarise(n_quadrats = n(), n_sites = n_distinct(site_name),
            islands = paste(sort(unique(island)), collapse = ", "), .groups = "drop")
n_total <- nrow(effort)
n_sites_total <- n_distinct(effort$site_name)

stopifnot(!anyNA(effort$year), !anyNA(effort$site_name))
knitr::kable(period_info, caption = "Quadrats, sites and islands sampled in each period.")
```

### Algae records with origin status

```{r algae}
algae <- master |>
  filter(resolution == "quadrat", category == "Algae") |>
  left_join(origin, by = "taxon_clean")

unclassified <- algae |> filter(is.na(origin_status)) |> distinct(taxon_clean)
if (nrow(unclassified) > 0) {
  stop("Algae missing from algae_origin_lookup.csv: ", paste(unclassified$taxon_clean, collapse = "; "))
}
```

## Summary for every algal taxon

`summarise_occurrence()` turns detection records into one row per group
with detection frequency by period (effort-corrected), distribution and
mean cover. It is used twice: once per taxon and once per origin status.

```{r summarise}
# Inputs : det    - one row per sample x group: sample_id, group columns, points
#          effort - every quadrat sampled: sample_id, period, site_name, island
#          ...    - the grouping columns
# Output : one row per group: % of quadrats recorded in each period and overall,
#          sites, islands, mean % cover where present, quadrats recorded
summarise_occurrence <- function(det, effort, ...) {
  grp <- names(select(det, ...))          # grouping column names, for the final join
  det <- det |>
    mutate(cover = pmin(points, 25) / 25) |>
    left_join(select(effort, sample_id, period, site_name, island), by = "sample_id")
  per_period <- det |>
    count(..., period, name = "n_det") |>
    left_join(count(effort, period, name = "n_quadrats"), by = "period") |>
    mutate(pct = 100 * n_det / n_quadrats) |>
    select(..., period, pct) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = period, values_from = pct, values_fill = 0, names_expand = TRUE)
  det |>
    group_by(...) |>
    summarise(quadrats_recorded = n_distinct(sample_id),
              pct_all = 100 * quadrats_recorded / nrow(effort),
              sites   = n_distinct(site_name),
              islands = n_distinct(island),
              cover   = 100 * mean(cover),
              .groups = "drop") |>
    left_join(per_period, by = grp)
}

by_taxon <- algae |>
  group_by(origin_status, taxon_clean, sample_id) |>
  summarise(points = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  summarise_occurrence(effort, origin_status, taxon_clean)

by_status <- algae |>
  group_by(origin_status, sample_id) |>
  summarise(points = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
  summarise_occurrence(effort, origin_status) |>
  left_join(count(by_taxon, origin_status, name = "n_taxa"), by = "origin_status")

# sanity checks: percentages are possible and per-taxon counts never exceed effort
stopifnot(all(by_taxon$pct_all <= 100), all(by_status$pct_all <= 100),
          all(by_taxon$quadrats_recorded <= n_total))

# every algal taxon, for anyone who wants more than the table shows
by_taxon |>
  arrange(factor(origin_status, STATUS_LEVELS), desc(pct_all)) |>
  rename(pct_2004_2008 = p1, pct_2016_2020 = p2, pct_2024_2026 = p3,
         pct_all_years = pct_all, mean_cover_when_present = cover) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  write_csv(file.path(OUT_DIR, "algae_origin_summary.csv"))
```

## The table

```{r build-table}
N_NATIVE_SHOWN <- 8

italicize <- function(x) {        # "Acanthophora spicifera" -> "*Acanthophora spicifera*"
  spp  <- str_detect(x, " spp\\.$")
  base <- str_remove(x, " spp\\.$")
  out  <- paste0("*", str_replace_all(base, "/", "*/*"), "*")
  ifelse(spp, paste0(out, " spp."), out)
}

n_native <- sum(by_taxon$origin_status == "Native (likely)")
SEC_ALL  <- "All algae, by origin status"
SEC_INV  <- "Invasive taxa"
SEC_NAT  <- paste0("Native taxa (", N_NATIVE_SHOWN, " most widespread of ", n_native, ")")

status_label <- c(
  "Non-native (invasive)"             = "Invasive species",
  "Native (likely)"                   = "Native species",
  "Unresolved (check)"                = "Species of uncertain origin",
  "Unresolved (genus-level)"          = "Identified to genus only",
  "Not assignable (functional group)" = "Functional groups (turf, corallines, crusts)")

display <- bind_rows(
  by_status |>
    arrange(factor(origin_status, STATUS_LEVELS)) |>
    mutate(section = SEC_ALL,
           label = paste0(status_label[origin_status], " (", n_taxa, " taxa)")),
  by_taxon |>
    filter(origin_status == "Non-native (invasive)") |>
    arrange(desc(pct_all), taxon_clean) |>
    mutate(section = SEC_INV, label = italicize(taxon_clean)),
  by_taxon |>
    filter(origin_status == "Native (likely)") |>
    arrange(desc(pct_all), taxon_clean) |>
    slice_head(n = N_NATIVE_SHOWN) |>
    mutate(section = SEC_NAT, label = italicize(taxon_clean))
) |>
  select(section, label, p1, p2, p3, pct_all, sites, islands, cover)

hdr <- function(p) {
  i <- period_info[period_info$period == p, ]
  md(paste0("**", PERIOD_LABELS[[p]], "**<br>", i$n_sites, " sites<br>",
            format(i$n_quadrats, big.mark = ","), " quadrats"))
}
p3_info   <- period_info[period_info$period == "p3", ]
func_pct  <- by_status$pct_all[by_status$origin_status == "Not assignable (functional group)"]
genus_row <- display$label[str_starts(display$label, "Identified to genus")]

algae_tbl <- display |>
  gt(groupname_col = "section") |>
  row_group_order(groups = c(SEC_ALL, SEC_INV, SEC_NAT)) |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = label) |>
  fmt_number(columns = c(p1, p2, p3, pct_all, cover), decimals = 1) |>
  cols_label(
    label   = "",
    p1      = hdr("p1"),
    p2      = hdr("p2"),
    p3      = hdr("p3"),
    pct_all = md(paste0("**All years**<br>", n_sites_total, " sites<br>",
                        format(n_total, big.mark = ","), " quadrats")),
    sites   = md("**Sites**"),
    islands = md("**Islands**"),
    cover   = md("**Mean cover<br>where present (%)**")
  ) |>
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Quadrats where recorded (%)**"),
              columns = c(p1, p2, p3, pct_all), id = "freq") |>
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Distribution**"), columns = c(sites, islands), id = "dist") |>
  tab_spanner(label = md("**Abundance**"), columns = cover, id = "abund") |>
  data_color(columns = c(p1, p2, p3, pct_all),
             palette = c("#FFFFFF", "#DEEBF7", "#9ECAE1", "#3182BD", "#08519C"),
             domain = c(0, 100)) |>
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = -label) |>
  cols_width(label ~ px(300), c(p1, p2, p3, pct_all) ~ px(92),
             c(sites, islands) ~ px(64), cover ~ px(104)) |>
  tab_header(
    title    = md("**Invasive and native algae in OPIHI intertidal surveys, 2004–2026**"),
    subtitle = "How often each alga was recorded, where, and how much space it covered when present"
  ) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste0("Percentage of 25-point quadrats in which the taxon was recorded (sampling effort ",
                      "in each header). Sites sampled differ between periods: 2024–2026 data come from ",
                      p3_info$n_sites, " sites on ", p3_info$islands, " only, so differences between ",
                      "periods partly reflect where sampling took place."),
    locations = cells_column_spanners(spanners = "freq")) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste0("Mean percentage of the 25 points covered by the taxon in quadrats where it was ",
                      "present. Older datasheets did not always record bare substrate, so cover is less ",
                      "comparable between periods than detection."),
    locations = cells_column_labels(columns = cover)) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md(paste0("Listed as introduced, invasive algae in Hawaiʻi (NOAA Hawaiʻi Integrated ",
                         "Ecosystem Assessment; U.S. Army Corps of Engineers). *Avrainvillea lacerata* ",
                         "includes records under its former name, *A. amadelpha*.")),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = SEC_INV)) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste0("Origin status from the team's algae origin lookup (Data/Algae). 'Native' ",
                      "statuses are provisional pending verification against a Hawaiian marine algae ",
                      "checklist. Only taxa identified to species are classed as native or invasive."),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = SEC_NAT)) |>
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = md(paste0("Includes common genera such as *Padina*, *Sargassum* and *Laurencia*; genera ",
                         "with both native and introduced species in Hawaiʻi (e.g. *Hypnea*, ",
                         "*Gracilaria*) cannot be assigned an origin.")),
    locations = cells_body(columns = label, rows = label == genus_row)) |>
  tab_source_note(md(paste0(
    "**Data:** OPIHI (Our Project In Hawaiʻi's Intertidal) monitoring data, cleaned master dataset ",
    "with team corrections (`opihi_master_completed.csv`); ",
    "quadrat-level point-intercept records only (", format(n_total, big.mark = ","), " quadrats at ",
    n_sites_total, " sites). Classroom group totals and cyanobacteria excluded. A quadrat counts once ",
    "per row even if several taxa in that row were recorded in it. Exploratory summary; no statistical ",
    "tests. Full per-taxon results: `Outputs/algae_origin_summary.csv`."))) |>
  opt_footnote_marks(marks = "letters") |>
  opt_table_font(font = c("Helvetica Neue", "Arial", "sans-serif")) |>
  tab_options(
    heading.align = "left",
    heading.title.font.size = px(18),
    heading.subtitle.font.size = px(13),
    heading.border.bottom.color = "black",
    table.font.size = px(13),
    table.border.top.color = "white",
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.top.color = "black",
    column_labels.border.bottom.color = "black",
    column_labels.font.size = px(12),
    row_group.font.weight = "bold",
    row_group.background.color = "#F3F4F6",
    row_group.border.top.color = "#BDBDBD",
    row_group.border.bottom.color = "#BDBDBD",
    table_body.hlines.color = "#ECECEC",
    data_row.padding = px(5),
    footnotes.font.size = px(11),
    source_notes.font.size = px(11),
    footnotes.multiline = TRUE
  )

algae_tbl
```

## Save the table

The PNG is made by `gt::gtsave()`, which uses the `webshot2` package and
a Chrome or Chromium browser installed on the computer. The HTML copy
needs neither.

```{r save-table}
png_path  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "algae_invasive_native_table.png")
html_path <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "algae_invasive_native_table.html")

gtsave(algae_tbl, html_path)
tryCatch(
  gtsave(algae_tbl, png_path, expand = 20, zoom = 2),
  error = function(e) message(
    "PNG not saved: ", conditionMessage(e),
    "\nThe PNG needs Google Chrome (or Chromium) installed. The HTML copy was saved to ", html_path)
)
list.files(OUT_DIR, pattern = "^algae_")
```

## Reading the table (exploratory)

```{r reading-values}
#| echo: false
st   <- \(s, col) round(by_status[[col]][by_status$origin_status == s], 1)
top  <- by_taxon |> filter(origin_status == "Non-native (invasive)") |> slice_max(pct_all, n = 1)
INV  <- "Non-native (invasive)"; NAT <- "Native (likely)"; GEN <- "Unresolved (genus-level)"
```

- Invasive species were recorded in `r st(INV, "pct_all")`% of quadrats,
  compared with `r st(NAT, "pct_all")`% for native species. They were
  found at `r st(INV, "sites")` of `r n_sites_total` sites on
  `r st(INV, "islands")` islands.
- *`r top$taxon_clean`* is the most widespread invasive
  (`r round(top$pct_all, 1)`% of quadrats, `r top$sites` sites).
- `r st(GEN, "pct_all")`% of quadrats contain algae identified only to
  genus, so a large part of the algal record cannot be assigned an
  origin.

All period-to-period differences are confounded by which sites were
sampled (see table note a). No statistical tests were run.

## Sources for invasive status

- NOAA Hawaiʻi Integrated Ecosystem Assessment, *Invasive alien
  species*: <https://integratedecosystemassessment.noaa.gov/node/194>
- U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (ERDC) webinar, *Avrainvillea erecta*
  (notes *A. lacerata*, formerly *A. amadelpha*, as the established
  invasive in Hawaiʻi):
  <https://CorpsLakes.erdc.dren.mil/employees/learning/webinars/19Aug28-Avrainvillea_erecta.pdf>
